summary: REE Automotive Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, announcing it has initiated a review of strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value. Alternatives include a potential sale, merger, reverse merger, partnership, licensing, or other transaction. The board has engaged TD Securities as financial advisor to assist with the expedited process. No specific transaction, price, or premium has been disclosed. The filing warns that the review may not result in a deal; any transaction would be subject to closing conditions including shareholder approval. Watch for announcements of a definitive agreement or, if none materializes, a potential wind-down or restructuring.
